text:
maya: Heads-up: noticed a cluster of negative invoice adjustments yesterday — many tied to promo credits (campaign: 'spring22') being applied twice. Filing here before I dig deeper. cc @tomas @priya

 t omas: Can you paste any example invoice ids / customer ids? quick check: could be double-enrichment from the promo service replaying messages.

 maya: Example: invoice_id=inv_2026_3345 account=acct_1023. Invoice shows two separate credit line items both -$50 coming from promo 'spring22'. I pulled the billing_events and see two promo_credit events with different event_id but same promo_id/account_id.

 priya: This smells like our dedupe key. The current pipeline dedupes on request_id for usage events, but promo_credit events come from the promo service and often don't have request_id. When the promo service retries/replays we end up with new event_id and we accept both.

 alex: Quick mitigation: add canonical_event_id at enrichment layer (hash of promo_id + account_id + created_at_floor). Then use that as the canonical id for dedupe. Example pseudo: 

 ```
 canonical_event_id = sha256(f"{promo_id}|{account_id}|{floor_ts}")
 kafka_key = f"{account_id}:{canonical_event_id}"
 ```

 wei: Repartitioning consumers is risky — some consumers rely on the current key for time-ordering. We should not change existing topic keys in place. Suggest: write enriched events to a new topic billing-ingest-v2 with the canonical key and let billing service opt-in to v2. That avoids immediate cross-consumer breakage.

 tomas: Agreed. In addition to canonical keys, we should add an idempotency check in billing service: maintain a short-lived idempotency store (redis or cockroach) keyed by tenant+canonical_event_id to reject duplicates. This protects even if duplicates slip through.

 priya: For reconciliation, here's a quick SQL to find duplicated promo credits per account/promo in the last 30 days:

 ```sql
 SELECT account_id, promo_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
 FROM billing_events
 WHERE event_type = 'promo_credit'
   AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
 GROUP BY account_id, promo_id
 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
 ```

 alex: I'll add a Grafana panel: invoice_adjustment_rate by promo_code (7d), and a table of top affected accounts. Also add alert if > 0.5% of invoices adjusted in a day. Who owns the dashboard adoption? @alex here — will do it today. :white_check_mark:

 billing-bot: Auto-report: 37 invoices adjusted in last 24h, total credits $4,820. Sample affected accounts: acct_1023, acct_984, acct_441.

 maya: Proposed plan: (1) add canonical_event_id enrichment + emit to billing-ingest-v2, (2) add idempotency check in billing service, (3) dashboard + alert, (4) backfill/dedupe for last 30 days and validate invoices. @alex own dashboard? @tomas own service change?

 tomas: I can pick up idempotency + topic migration. Prototype in 2 days, canary rollout 1 day. Will create RFC and a small migration plan to ensure ordering-sensitive consumers are unaffected.

 priya: I'll write the backfill script and validation queries. Plan to run in staging first and produce a reconciliation report. I'll also prepare a brief postmortem note once we confirm RCA.

 maya: Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: tomas, share the proto for idempotency API (GET/SET with TTL) and the migration checklist. alex, add the panel + a dashboard link here when done. I'll open a billing escalation ticket for any customers with invoices already emailed. :pray:
